description:
Discover Bass Lake on a fun and family-friendly eBike adventure designed for riders of all experience levels. This guided tour begins near the shores of Bass Lake and follows a scenic forest road that parallels the lake.
Along the way, you'll visit several historic landmarks that tell the story of Bass Lake's rich past. Highlights include the iconic logging town of Wishon, Bass Lake Dam, and other points of interest that showcase the area's logging and recreational heritage. As you ride, enjoy beautiful views of the sparkling lake, towering pine forests, and the surrounding Sierra Nevada landscape.

The tour continues up Central Camp Road, a historic route that was once part of the railroad system used during the region's logging era. Thanks to the assistance of modern eBikes, the gradual climb is enjoyable for riders of all ages, allowing everyone to take in the scenery without feeling rushed.

At the top, we'll arrive at Bass Lake View, one of the area's most scenic overlooks. With panoramic views of the lake and surrounding mountains, it's the perfect place to relax, enjoy a picnic, take photos, and soak in the beauty of the Sierra National Forest.

After the break, the adventure becomes even more enjoyable as the remainder of the ride is primarily downhill, allowing you to cruise comfortably back toward the lake while enjoying the fresh mountain air and spectacular scenery. This tour offers the perfect combination of history, nature, family fun, and effortless exploration of one of California's most beautiful mountain destinations. Round trip 20 miles
